content:
incident-bot: Pager: metering-emit-delay — Severity: P2. Several customers showing delayed usage and transient overage flags. Alerting from billing-validator.

maria: oncall here, looking now. which region?

incident-bot: affected cluster: eu-west-1-emitter-prod. Windowed emits delayed ~15-20m, token counts lagging. First spike at 1777771120.

dan: I'm seeing increased consumer queue depth on emitter-stream-2, likely the backlog. Replaying is already throttled.

maria: ok. @chris can you check emitter pod logs? I'll check billing ingestion.

chris: tailing logs, here's recent error pattern: 
```
WARN emitter: kafka-write-timeout partition=12 offset=345678 err=WriteTimeout
INFO emitter: retrying message batch
```
Backpressure from the broker during a short GC/leader-flap.

ameer: customers getting overage flags from the validator due to delayed windows — some flags auto-fired at 00:00 UTC because counts didn't arrive on time. We should suppress transient overage notifications if we plan a replay.

maria: agree. mitigation plan: 1) suppress new overage alerts for impacted shard range 12-15, 2) increase emitter retry backoff to avoid tight loops, 3) start replay for 15m backlog with rate cap. Doing (1) now.

support-bot: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-delay - steps for alert suppression and replay.

maria: suppression applied to billing-validator alerting rules for shard 12-15 :white_check_mark: (suppression id sup-2026-17777).

dan: I can patch emitter config and roll one pod to pick up increased retry/backoff. Patch ready: `emitter.retry.backoff.ms=5000 -> 15000`

chris: rolling pod emitter-2a -> `kubectl rollout restart deployment/emitter-prod -n metering --grace-period=30`

maria: starting controlled replay of backlog to validator: `scripts/replay_backlog --shards=12-15 --rate=200/s --start=1777771000`

chris: logs show writes healthy after restart, no new WriteTimeouts for last 30s.

ameer: thanks. I've paused overage emails to customers impacted by sup-2026-17777 and created an internal ticket to remove flags after reconciliation. Ticket: BILL-17777.

support-bot: customer-impact note posted to #support: "Customers may see temporary overage flags between 23:45-00:10 UTC. We are replaying telemetry; no billing will be applied until reconciliation completes."

maria: rough ETA for reconciliation? If replay proceeds at 200/s per shard we should catch up in ~10-12m. Monitoring.

dan: replay progressing, current backlog processed ~65%. rate stable.

chris: validator ingest shows window backfill arriving; token counts for sample customer `acme-co` incrementing, previous overage flag cleared in staging flow.

ameer: I'm running a quick query to calculate drift delta for affected windows: `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM usage WHERE shard in (12,13,14,15) AND ts BETWEEN 1777771000 AND 1777771300` — will compare pre/post replay.

maria: nice. once replay finishes we'll trigger manual reconcile and flip suppression off. Hold escalation until drift < 5% or manual check.

support-bot: external incident notice drafted for affected customers. Please review: https://redwood.internal/incidents/drafts/metering-delay-177777

chris: replay complete. emitter logs stable. No further kafka timeouts.

dan: rolling back retry backoff to safer baseline after warm-up.

ameer: drift check: pre-replay aggregated tokens 1,048,120; post-replay 1,053,600 -> delta +0.52% (within threshold). Clearing flags for impacted customers now.

maria: suppression removed (sup-2026-17777) :white_check_mark:. Overages cleared, overage emails suppressed earlier will not be resent.

support-bot: internal status update posted to #support and #incidents.

maria: root cause: transient kafka leader GC/leader-flap caused short emitter write timeouts, which delayed emits and triggered validator thresholds. Action items: (A) add proactive leader-metrics alert, (B) add replay-safe suppression to validator for short windows, (C) follow up with infra to investigate broker GC. Assigning follow-ups to @chris (broker logs) and @ameer (validator suppression feature).

chris: will capture broker GC logs and open infra ticket INFRA-889.

ameer: will write a small suppress-if-replay-expected feature spec and share tomorrow.

maria: thanks team. Monitoring for 30m then close. Incident resolved for now.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: metering-emit-delay. Duration: ~28m. Postmortem required: yes. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/postmortems/1777771234
